headline: Nifty 50 *tumbles* 1.64% as FII outflows hit hard
subline: Broad market sell-off with significant FII outflows.
hero_text: The market fell sharply today, with Nifty dropping 1.64% as FIIs exited heavily.

why.title: Surge in Volatility
why.desc: India VIX spiked sharply indicating nervousness.

why.title: Financial Strain
why.desc: Financial stocks dragged down the market.

movers_note_gainers: Cipla led the gainers with a slight uptick.
movers_note_losers: HDFC Life and Bajaj Finance were among the top losers.
watch_text: Keep an eye on BOE Gov Bailey's speech and UoM data tomorrow.
lessons: FII outflows can significantly impact market sentiment.
Rising VIX indicates increased market volatility.
Sectoral declines can drive broader market downturns.
Monitoring institutional flows is crucial for market insights.
alert_text: Watch for BOE Gov Bailey's speech and UoM data releases tomorrow.
next_text: Friday brings BOE speech and UoM data releases.
